name: Frihet ERP
description: Candidate inventory for the local Frihet Muse stdio profile. Remote Muse integration, authentication and partner acceptance are not established by this document.

tools.name: get_business_context
tools.description: Get high-level business profile, default currency, fiscal country, and operating summary.

tools.name: get_monthly_summary
tools.description: Retrieve financial summary (revenue, expenses, net margin, cash balance) for a specific month.

tools.name: get_quarterly_taxes
tools.description: Retrieve quarterly tax estimates; this read does not file a tax declaration.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List issued customer invoices with pagination and status filters (draft, sent, paid, overdue).

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Retrieve full details and line items of a specific customer invoice by ID.

tools.name: search_invoices
tools.description: Search invoices using the supported server query filters.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a customer invoice with status forced to draft by the local Muse profile; this tool does not issue or send it.

tools.name: list_expenses
tools.description: List business expenses with date range and category filters.

tools.name: get_expense
tools.description: Retrieve details and breakdown of a recorded business expense by ID.

tools.name: create_expense
tools.description: Create a business expense record with amount, vendor, category and deductible tax; this local profile does not force draft status.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: List registered clients and business contacts.

tools.name: get_client
tools.description: Retrieve the client profile returned by the API; the local profile applies configured output redaction.

tools.name: create_client
tools.description: Register a new client record with contact email, trade name, and billing details.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List products and service items in the business catalog with pricing and tax codes.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Retrieve pricing, SKU, description, and standard tax rate of a specific product.

tools.name: list_quotes
tools.description: List customer commercial quotes and estimates with status filters.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Retrieve full quote details, line items, and expiration date.

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description: Create a commercial quote with status forced to draft by the local Muse profile; this tool does not send it.

outputRedaction.policy: Named sensitive fields are removed from structured results; matching serialized JSON fields are removed from text.
outputRedaction.limit: This is not general anonymization of names, emails, addresses or arbitrary prose.

idempotency.policy: The shared HTTP client supplies a request idempotency key and reuses it for its retries.
idempotency.limit: Separate tool invocations can receive separate keys; semantic deduplication is not guaranteed.

governance.audit: Operational logging does not establish a Muse-specific tamper-evident audit trail.
